style: Photorealistic outback mining landscape at sunset, a pale sandstone hillside with dugout doorways cut into the rock, white cone-shaped heaps of dug earth on red ground, a small timber mine headframe on the ridge
continuity: the framing, horizon and every landmark remain fixed and the scene settles into the framing shown in Picture 2 at the end of the shot, matching the first frame so the clip can loop.
ambience: A dry desert wind over open ground

segments.camera: The camera holds a locked-off static wide shot.
segments.action: A thin veil of dust drifts low across the red ground throughout the shot. Clouds drift slowly to the left, a thin veil of dust drifts to the right near the ground, and the dry shrubs tremble in a hot breeze. The hillside, the white heaps and the headframe stay still.
